gloss: toddler food; food for young children

definitions.gloss: toddler food; food for young children
definitions.explanation: meals and food products designed for children roughly ages 1 to 5, transitioning from baby food to regular adult meals

notes:
Combines ⟦{幼児|ようじ}→幼児：12478_youji⟧ (infant, toddler) and {食|しょく} (food, meal). Refers to the stage of eating between ⟦{離乳食|りにゅうしょく}→離乳食：14883_rinyuushoku⟧ (weaning food/baby food) and regular meals. In Japan, there are many commercial products, cookbooks, and parenting resources dedicated to this stage of childhood nutrition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幼児食|ようじしょく}⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧: toddler food recipe
- {幼児食|ようじしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移行|いこう}→移行：13776_ikou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to transition to toddler food
- {幼児食|ようじしょく}⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧: toddler food menu
- ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幼児食|ようじしょく}: commercially available toddler food

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{離乳食|りにゅうしょく}→離乳食：14883_rinyuushoku⟧: baby food, weaning food — food for the earlier stage (around 5-18 months)
